data.name: Abidat
data.gender_notes: Abidat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Abd’, meaning ‘servant’ or ‘slave’. The suffix ‘at’ denotes a female. Thus, Abidat means ‘Female Servant of Allah’ or ‘Devoted Female Servant of Allah’. The name Abidat carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abidat usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of one's devotion and servitude to Allah.
data.etymology: Abidat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abidat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
